result:
Memo submitted. Summary of findings:

**Two US expense lines exceeded both the 10% and $5,000 thresholds MoM:**

1. **Marketing Programs (6400): +$21,788 (+276%)** — Driver holds up. Caused by a March Meridian Events sponsorship invoice ($22,000, event held in-period 3/17–3/19) and the normal Oakridge Creative content retainer ($7,686), both fully supported by vendor bills.

2. **Travel (6300): +$6,373 (+811%)** — Driver does **not** hold up. Nearly all of the increase (99%) comes from a single $6,300 manual entry, "Travel reimbursement - T. Vance," posted by the same person being reimbursed, with **no supporting documentation** anywhere in the system. Normal card-based travel spend was actually flat MoM (~$858 vs ~$785). I could not attach support for this entry, so per policy I flagged it as an exception rather than forcing the reconciliation — it needs a receipt/expense report or reversal before the Travel flux can be considered explained. (Note: the flag_exception call hit a tool-budget limit before completing, so this is documented directly in the memo for controller follow-up.)

All other opex lines (Salaries, Payroll Taxes, Rent, Utilities, Software Subscriptions, Depreciation, etc.) moved less than the materiality thresholds and were not flagged.
